notes: Reviewed Argo’s current website, the May 8, 2026 Form ADV private-fund schedule, regulatory ownership filings, public-pension holdings, fund-close reporting, and current portfolio-company releases.
Apollo’s proposed acquisition of Argo was separately checked and had been terminated after failing to close by January 10, 2026; Argo therefore remains the canonical manager.
Master-feeder schedules, AIVs, sidecars, and the K Series 3 parallel vehicle were reviewed to avoid double-counting.
One additional fund-close article was inaccessible and was not used as evidence; the accessible secondary close report remains a review-only input.
